screen.jem_lighting_sandbox.title: Lighting preview · Drag to orbit
screen.jem_lighting_sandbox.unavailable: Lighting shader unavailable. See the client log.
screen.jem_lighting_sandbox.settings.fol: Use the current Minecraft render distance for lighting, up to 32 chunks.
screen.jem_lighting_sandbox.settings.dis: Maximum distance from a light to a surface. Weaker lights can have a shorter range.
screen.jem_lighting_sandbox.settings.atm: Show biome fog, sky tint, weather effects and canopy leaves.
screen.jem_lighting_sandbox.settings.sha: Controls celestial shadow map resolution and the number of samples per luminous block face.
screen.jem_lighting_sandbox.settings.ena: Use JEM terrain lighting and atmosphere effects.
screen.jem_lighting_sandbox.settings.mod: Choose how quickly JEM updates light and shadows when blocks change.
screen.jem_lighting_sandbox.settings.man: Set the range for detailed local light in loaded chunks.
screen.jem_lighting_sandbox.settings.rai: Set particle density for ordinary rain, snow and sand.
screen.jem_lighting_sandbox.settings.dar: Use darker particles for campfire smoke.
screen.jem_lighting_sandbox.settings.win: Show outdoor trails that follow the wind.
screen.jem_lighting_sandbox.settings.riv: Show low mist above rivers and other bodies of water.
screen.jem_lighting_sandbox.settings.sno: Show drifting snow near the ground.
screen.jem_lighting_sandbox.settings.cav: Show dust suspended in cave air.
screen.jem_lighting_sandbox.settings.can: Show leaves falling from tree canopies.
screen.jem_lighting_sandbox.settings.win: Enter biome_id=#RRGGBB. Separate entries with commas. Remove an entry to restore its default color. Red text marks an invalid edit.
